rules: This manifest permits neither direct database writes nor automatic Cloudinary uploads.
Every sourceUrl is a direct image URL verified HTTP 200 with an image/* content-type on 2026-10-22; re-verify before upload.
Only a verified Cloudinary URL may be applied to the catalogue; hold entries are excluded.

assets.rightsBasis: Official Joy University header logo served from the university's own domain (site-wide header on joyuniversity.edu.in). No open licence - used only to identify the institution. Checked 2026-10-22: HTTP 200, content-type image/png, 16,532 bytes, 338x47 px. Rendered on white and visually confirmed: maroon 'J' monogram, grey 'JOY UNIVERSITY' wordmark and the strapline 'Established vide Tamil Nadu State Pvt. Universities Act 2019 - UGC Recognised' - legible on a white tile. CAVEAT: small raster (338 px wide); no SVG or larger brand asset found. The footer logo (images/footer-logo.png) is white-on-transparent and was rejected.

Official campus photograph on the university domain, first image in the Infrastructures page gallery (Campus Overview). No open licence stated - official institutional image used to identify the institution, same basis as earlier official covers in research/media-enrichment/india-batch-3-upload-manifest.json. Checked 2026-10-22: HTTP 200, content-type image/jpeg, 543,918 bytes, 1280x752 px (landscape). Visual confirmation: aerial view of the Raja Nagar campus at dusk - blue-and-white academic blocks, a round building, green quadrangles and the Our Lady of Lourdes chapel sign, with wind turbines and the Western Ghats behind. No text overlay or watermark.
assets.altText: Aerial view of Joy University's campus at Vadakkankulam, Tamil Nadu, with academic blocks and lawns in the foreground and wind turbines and hills behind
